name: thread_create
description: Split a sub-task out of the thread you are working on and assign a peer to it. The sub-thread always hangs off your current thread and shares its budget, so splitting work cannot mint more model time. Pass assignee in this call; naming a peer in the title or body does not assign them.

body.description: What the assignee needs to know to start.

acceptanceCriteria.description: What "done" means for this sub-task. The assignee is told this and reports against it.

assignee.description: Name of an enabled peer to assign, as listed in your run frame. Assigning starts them.
